situations.title: Not in the list — AI help
situations.hint: Describe the problem in your own words (sounds, behavior, when it started)

situations.title: Won't start
situations.hint: Cranks but won't catch, clicks, or total silence

followup.question: What happens when you turn the key or press Start?

choices.label: Total silence — dash dead or dies immediately
Clicks under the hood, but the engine won't crank
Starter spins very fast/easy (freewheeling) but never catches
Cranks normally, coughs, catches, then dies

situations.title: Wheel / tire / rim
situations.hint: Puncture, cut, steering shake, bent rim

followup.question: What condition is the wheel in, and can you roll on it?

choices.label: Screw/puncture — tire going down slowly
Tire shredded (sidewall) or rim badly bent
Wheel looks OK, but shakes hard in the wheel or body at speed

situations.title: Check Engine
situations.hint: Solid, flashing, no power, warning cluster

followup.question: How is the Check Engine light behaving, and how does the car drive?

choices.label: Check flashing, rough misfire, no power
Check solid, car drives normally
Check solid, but car won't go (limp mode, no revs)

situations.title: Brakes
situations.hint: Squeal, grind, soft or rock-hard pedal, vibration when braking

followup.question: What exactly worries you about the brakes?

choices.label: Squeal/whistle when stopping, still brakes OK
Harsh metal grinding when you press the pedal
Pedal soft/sinks to the floor, or rock-hard

situations.title: Strange noise / knocks
situations.hint: Bump knocks, hum, whine, click on turns

followup.question: What kind of noise is it, and when does it show up?

choices.label: Dull or sharp knock from below on bumps/rails/waves
Rising hum/whine (like an airplane) that follows road speed
Loud click/crunch at the front when turning from a stop

situations.title: Engine overheating
situations.hint: Temp gauge in the red, steam, coolant smell

followup.question: What do you see right now on the dash or under the hood?

choices.label: Steam billowing from the hood, fluid spraying
No steam, but temp needle in the red (or red temp light)

situations.title: Other warning light (red/yellow)
situations.hint: Red oil can, battery icon, ABS, ESP, airbag

followup.question: Which important indicator lit on the dash?

choices.label: RED oil can light (oil pressure)
RED battery icon (no charging)
Yellow ABS, skidding-car (ESP), or Brake light

situations.title: Transmission (AT / MT)
situations.hint: Shudders, delayed shifts, slips, won't engage

followup.question: How exactly is the transmission behaving?

choices.label: Automatic kicks, shoves, or jerks on shifts
Revs climb, engine roars, but the car won't accelerate (slips)
Gear locked, shifter stuck, or transmission limp mode

situations.title: Leaks / drips under the car
situations.hint: Spots on asphalt, oil drip, coolant loss

followup.question: What color are the fresh drips, and where did you see them?

choices.label: Black or brown greasy drips under engine or gearbox
Pink, green, or blue sweet chemical fluid
Clear water dripping near the front passenger side

situations.title: Climate / A/C / Heater
situations.hint: Blows hot in summer, no heat in winter, smell, noise

followup.question: What's wrong with the cabin air?

choices.label: A/C turns on but blows warm air
Musty/mold/dust smell when the blower starts
Heater blows cold in winter (engine already warm)

situations.title: Exhaust smoke
situations.hint: Blue/gray, thick white, or black smoke

followup.question: What color is the exhaust smoke?

choices.label: Blue/gray smoke with a burnt-oil smell
Thick black smoke, sluggish, high fuel use
Thick white smoke (steam-like) that stays after warmup

situations.title: Smell / hazardous puddle
situations.hint: Fuel, burning smell, smoke not from the pipe

choices.label: Fuel smell / fuel puddle
Burning smell / smoke from under hood or car
